ITEM.PTXT: The light control computer achieves instant and stable illumination of the HID bulb through controls such as generating a high voltage of up to approximately 22,000V. Since this device generates high voltage, various fail-safe functions are incorporated, and consideration has also been given to ensuring reliability against heat, humidity, vibration, etc.

ENTRY.PTXT: 1. The battery voltage is converted into a high-voltage pulse (approximately 22,000V) by the light control computer in the lamp.
2. The high-voltage pulse is applied between both electrodes of the bulb, causing the xenon gas to emit light.
3. Arc discharge occurs as the temperature inside the bulb rises.
4. As the temperature rises further, the metal iodide vaporizes and separates, and the metal atoms emit light by discharge.
5. The light control computer optimally controls the power supplied to the bulb.
